messages:
anya: FYI I rolled a tiny canary of orpheus-13b-int4v2 with extended-window flags set (+64k). quick smoke passed but our long-prefill goldset shows position-dependent token deltas after token 49152. filing here so we don't lose context.

ram: can you paste the exact invocation and the offending log lines?

anya: invocation:
```bash
./run_eval.sh --model=orpheus-13b-int4v2 --prefill=50000 --quant=int4v2 --trace=kv_index,rotary
```
log excerpt:
```
[2025-11-02T12:11:23Z] kv.write: req_pos=49160 stored_pos=16384
[2025-11-02T12:11:23Z] kv.read: req_pos=49160 served_pos=16384
[2025-11-02T12:11:23Z] attn.apply_rotary: pos_mismatch req=49160 used=16384
[2025-11-02T12:11:23Z] gen: token="the" prob_delta=0.012
```

lucas: that stored_pos=16384 smells like a 14-bit mask (0x3FFF) or a signed shift. our Int4 fast path has a legacy `POS_MASK` defined for 16k windows in a header that some builds still pick up.

ram: weird — i thought we lifted all masks to 32-bit when we added 64k support. could be a build config drift between canary and release images. which image tag are you on?

anya: canary tag: orpheus-13b-int4v2-canary-20251102-1. release/main is orpheus-13b-int4v2-20251028.

qa: i ran a deterministic prefill locally and reproduced. delta positions cluster around 49152-49220. i attached a tiny repro harness (1-file) that exercises only the kv-indexing helpers and rotary mapping. keeps everything single-threaded so it's deterministic.

lucas: ok quick plan: (a) grep for any POS_MASK/shift constants in fast-kernel and scalar kernel, (b) add an assertion that rejects wrapping (only in dev mode), (c) add a diagnostic mode that dumps kv.index.table for last N writes when seq>32k.

ram: adding (d) patch to fix build flags that pick the old header. i suspect a stale include is overriding the global define. will open PR and CI will build both x86 and nvidia containers.

anya: thanks. small ask: when we roll the fix, let's run a cross-compare: run prefill on float32 and int4v2 with identical RNG seeds and diff token probs across the longprefill goldset. i want to see if the regression is purely positional (i.e., tokens match if indices fixed) vs amplified by quant noise.

lucas: agreed. also we should add a micro-benchmark that auto-generates sequences at different offsets (16k,32k,48k,64k) and asserts no index aliasing. can be part of the kernel unit tests.

qa: i'm on it. will paste test PR once green. also adding tests that run in CI with trace enabled but no perf cost on main runs.

ops-bot: CI pipeline started: build-orpheus-int4v2/patch-1798765433. Running unit-kernel-tests, integration-canary-smoke.

ram: one more note: there is a corner in our sharded KV layout where global_pos -> shard_slot uses `% SHARD_SZ` then a cast to 16-bit for the slot index. if SHARD_SZ > 32768 this cast will clip. double-checking now.

anya: good catch. if true then the fix needs to be at both the sharding math and kernel mask. otherwise we patch one place and still get aliasing later.

lucas: i'll audit sharding code. if we need a rolling migration we can add a compatibility mode that refuses to serve requests with seq_len > SHARD_SZ for older shards and cause a safe rebuild. but hopefully not necessary.

qa: short-term mitigation: enable kv.prefix-eviction when seq_len > 40k so we avoid writing beyond safe bounds until patch lands. that will impact quality for very long prompts but keeps correctness.

anya: ok enable eviction on canary only and keep traces on. i'll rerun goldset after ram's patch lands. leaving results here. :thumbsup:
